text:
marc: Quick follow-up on the PM postmortem for the cache-throttle incident — proposing we triage the action backlog this week. TL;DR: need owners for infra, runtime, and docs; confirm Jira links; watch for recurrence pattern.

elaine: +1. I can take infra owner for "ensure eviction visibility" (JIRA RINF-4310). ETA end of week? Also saw similar spikes 3x in the last 60 days — filing that pattern in the ticket.

rajesh: I'll take runtime optimization (RINF-4321). Plan: reproduce with loadbench, add KV cache telemetry, then patch. Can we scope whether it's a perf regression vs config drift?

ana: I'll own docs/runbook updates (RINF-4332). Need clarity on the escalation step: when do we flip to Dedicated fallback in the playbook — is that currently in the RACI?

marc: Proposed RACI for these items: infra=elaine (A), runtime=rajesh (R), docs=ana (C), product/PO=marc (I). Owners: please add acceptance criteria in the Jira ticket by Wed. I'll update the postmortem with this mapping.

elaine: AC added to RINF-4310: dashboard for cache hit/evict, alert thresholds, weekly job to surface tombstone growth. Also ran `kubectl get pods -n redwood-runtime -l app=cache` — saw 2 pods in CrashLoopBackoff; added note to ticket.

oncall-bot: Reminder set — weekly check scheduled Fri 09:00 UTC. (automated)

rajesh: Runtime blocker: need access to the dedicated perf pool for repro and profiling. Requesting temp creds for `rdedicated-test`. ETA for fix: ~2 weeks once I have access.

infra-team: Granted 48h access to `rdedicated-test`. DM infra-team for creds. Also flagged config drift item RINF-4299 — may be related to the eviction tuning.

ana: I'll draft the runbook PR with the new steps and an abbreviated on-call playbook (who to page, quick mitigation commands). Example mitigation snippet I'll include:
```
kubectl scale deploy/cache --replicas=3 -n redwood-runtime
# then check cache metrics dashboard
```

marc: Thanks everyone. I'll consolidate owners and ACs into the postmortem doc, create three weekly checkpoints to monitor recurrence metrics, and escalate to an ops deep-dive if we see >1 repeat. :thumbsup:
